inputs.name: containers
inputs.type:
map(object({
    image       = string
    ports       = optional(list(string), [])
    volumes     = optional(list(string), [])
    environment = optional(map(string), {})
    extra       = optional(list(string), [])
    auto_update = optional(bool, false)
  }))
inputs.description: Containers to run as systemd services through Quadlet, by name. Each becomes /etc/containers/systemd/NAME.container and the service NAME.service.

inputs.name: secrets
inputs.description: Secret environment variables by container name, such as { app = { DB_PASSWORD = "..." } }. They go to /etc/containers/env/NAME.env with mode 0600 and never reach state or the plan.

inputs.name: registries
inputs.description: Registries to search for short image names, such as ["docker.io"]. Give one: with two or more, Podman refuses short names when it has no terminal to ask on, as under systemd. When empty, the distribution's own setting stays.

inputs.name: auto_update_timer
inputs.description: Start podman-auto-update.timer, which pulls new images for containers with auto_update once a day and restarts them.
